description: This file implements a SQL store for managing cluster discovery data in Mattermost, including methods for saving, deleting, checking existence, retrieving, updating last ping time, and cleaning up cluster discovery records.

classes.name: sqlClusterDiscoveryStore
classes.description: Implements the ClusterDiscoveryStore interface for managing cluster discovery data in SQL.

methods.name: newSqlClusterDiscoveryStore
methods.description: Creates a new instance of sqlClusterDiscoveryStore with initialized query builder.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a ClusterDiscovery record into the database after validation.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a ClusterDiscovery record based on type, cluster name, and hostname.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if a ClusterDiscovery record exists in the database.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all ClusterDiscovery records of a specific type and cluster name, filtering by last ping time.

methods.name: SetLastPingAt
methods.description: Updates the LastPingAt timestamp for a specific ClusterDiscovery record.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes ClusterDiscovery records that have not pinged recently, based on a timeout.
